sideB.text:
DAR ES SALAAM

Yellow city art with a white upgrade panel and a green ring. No other text.

rules: Yellow Infection card for Dar es Salaam.
The white center panel is the infection-card upgrade slot. The green ring is standard infection-card art.
notes: Goes to the reserve when the package is opened. The other Dar es Salaam Infection card is P7-10b.
